description: This file defines a custom Flutter widget called OceanButton, which is a styled primary action button used within the Ocean Professional theme for the attendance tracker app. The widget supports loading state, optional icon, and full-width display.

classes.name: OceanButton
classes.description: A customized Flutter button widget styled for the Ocean Professional theme, used for prominent actions like 'Mark Attendance'.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the OceanButton, displaying either a loading indicator or label and icon, styled as an ElevatedButton with optional full-width layout.
